mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_post_vote (post_id, question, multiple_choice) VALUES (#{postId}, #{question}, #{multipleChoice})
INSERT INTO project_post_vote_option (vote_id, option_text, order_no) VALUES (#{voteId}, #{optionText}, #{orderNo})
mapper.select: SELECT vote_id FROM project_post_vote WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT option_id as optionId, vote_id as voteId, option_text as optionText, order_no as orderNo FROM project_post_vote_option WHERE vote_id = #{voteId} ORDER BY order_no
SELECT v.vote_id AS voteId, v.question AS question, v.created_at AS createdAt FROM project_post_vote v WHERE v.post_id = #{postId}
SELECT vote_id AS voteId, post_id AS postId, question AS question, multiple_choice AS multipleChoice FROM project_post_vote WHERE post_id = #{postId}
